messages:
marta: Heads-up — console is showing missing aggregate counts for EU 02:00-03:00 UTC. Looks like late firehose/partitioning issues. I want to run a targeted rescue pass for that hour. Any objections?

kai: +1. We need to plan slots and quota so this doesn't disrupt other replays. how many concurrent workers are we thinking?

dominik: oncall here. I saw a write spike and a few node GC pauses around 02:10. Suggest conservative concurrency and a circuit-breaker: abort if write error rate > 1%.

ryan: runtime note: our rehydrate tool supports --idempotent and KV cache priming. For a 1hr slice I'd recommend max-concurrency 6, backoff 30s, and a 5m KV warmup phase. That keeps throughput steady and avoids thundering.

marta: proposed config: priority=low, slots=6, backoff=30s, max-ops-per-tenant=50, abort-if-error-rate>1% (0.01). fallback behavior => incremental partial-apply if full run is preempted. thoughts?

jenna: product/console: can we surface a small "rescue run" modal with estimated cost + ETA + an abort button? customers got confused last time when a rescue run kicked off without context.

console-team: we can add a quick card. estimates come from backfill-estimator service — we should show token estimate + risk flag. also include a run-id link to traces.

kai: routing question: should these go via the shared batch pool or a dedicated lane? my vote is dedicated batch pool with a quota-multiplier 0.2 so rescue runs can't starve normal throughput.

marta: agree. route to dedicated batch pool and set quota-multiplier=0.2. also add model-variant fallback if primary model isn't available.

platform-bot: Deploy triggered: backfill-coordinator v2.8 -> slot-allocator changes applied.

dominik: ops run command (if we need to kick manually):
```bash
./infra/tools/rescue_run \\  --start '2026-03-12T02:00:00Z' \\  --end '2026-03-12T03:00:00Z' \\  --priority low \\  --max-concurrency 6 \\  --max-ops-per-tenant 50 \\  --abort-error-rate 0.01 \\  --kv-warmup 300
```

marta: I'll kick this off in ~10m. tagging @ops-oncall to monitor.

ops-oncall: watching. I'll add temporary alerts: p95 latency > 0.5s and error-rate > 0.5% for early warning; will escalate at >1%.

ryan: also enable structured trace key tracer=rescue-20260312 for easier postmortem slicing.

jenna: console-team — can you add the run-id link to the status panel? that link made debugging way faster last time.

console-team: yes — will surface run-id and quick trace link. UI ETA ~2h, but we can show a temporary banner with run-id immediately.

marta: launched: run id rescue-20260312-1. progress: starting prefix-warmup phase. will post updates or abort if threshold hit.

platform-bot: backfill-coordinator: job rescue-20260312-1 started on pool batch-dedicated-4, slots=6.

dominik: initial applys coming through — current error rate ~0.2% (within thresh). :thumbsup:

marta: thanks all — update in 30m or sooner if we exceed 1% error rate.
